label.text: Each device a user gets notifications on: a browser, the app through Firebase, or the app through a UnifiedPush distributor. A device that acknowledges the pushes it shows (it has acknowledged one before) is marked when pushes of the last day went unacknowledged: it is not showing them. A device that never acknowledged one, such as an older app, is not marked.
No devices yet. A device appears when a user turns notifications on in a browser or signs in with the app.
